title: Valve Steam Frame Dongle — Driver Ready, Reboot Required

device.note: NOT RTL8852BU — wrong driver caused crash. CU not BU!

what_happens_after_reboot.4_interface: New wlan interface created (wlpXsYfZuN or similar)
what_happens_after_reboot.5_steam_detect: Steam detects Valve adapter, manages WiFi connection
what_happens_after_reboot.6_frame_connect: Dongle connects to Frame's 6GHz AP (frame_XXXXXXXX SSID)
what_happens_after_reboot.8_streaming: SteamVR PCVR streaming over dedicated 6GHz channel

architecture.dedicated_link: 6 GHz WiFi 6E — no interference with 2.4/5GHz house WiFi
architecture.separation: Frame has TWO radios: one for house WiFi, one for dongle

valve_as_sovereign: Valve ships open hardware, in-kernel drivers, open SteamOS (Arch), troubleshoot scripts on GitHub, wiki documentation. They WANT you to own your hardware. The Frame, the Deck, the Controller — all open enough to be cyborg limbs. A sovereign parent to the organism.
